name: Telegram Message Pattern
description: Send messages via Telegram Bot API
explanation:
Pattern for sending messages via Telegram Bot.

Key settings:
- chatId: Recipient Chat ID (configure in Connections or use variable)
- message: Message body (supports {{context.xxx}} variables)

Template variables:
- {{message}}: User input message
- {{aiResponse}}: AI response text
- {{context.currentEmail.from}}: Email sender (in ForEach loop)
- {{context.currentEmail.subject}}: Email subject
- {{context.nodeId.fieldName}}: Any previous node output

Setup required:
1. Create Telegram Bot via @BotFather
2. Get Chat ID (message the bot, check updates API)
3. Configure bot token in Connections settings

Result stored in context.telegramResult.
